description: This Java source file defines the PricingResolutionFlow class, which handles the logic for resolving the effective price of a product SKU in a specific store and currency. It processes pricing requests, interacts with a repository to retrieve price data, applies sale or regular pricing based on the sale window, and computes unit and extended prices with logging and validation.

classes.name: PricingResolutionFlow
classes.description: Main service class responsible for resolving product pricing based on store, SKU, currency, quantity, and timestamp. Handles validation, price retrieval, sale window checks, and computes the final pricing result.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Public method that processes a pricing request, validates inputs, retrieves active price data, determines applicable price (sale or regular), calculates total and unit prices, and returns a PricingResolution object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the pricing request for nulls, blank fields, currency code length, and positive quantity.

methods.name: determineAppliedPrice
methods.description: Decides whether to apply sale or regular price based on sale window visibility at the given timestamp.

methods.name: isWithinSaleWindow
methods.description: Checks if a given timestamp falls within the defined sale start and end window.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Utility method to check if a string is null or whitespace.
